assets.properties.title: Properties
assets.programTarget.title: Listed by a bug-bounty program. Tags from programs are set by the platform and cannot be edited.
assets.overview.title: Assets
assets.overview.description: Everything your organization owns that can be attacked, by area.
assets.overview.duplicatesHint: Some assets look like the same thing: approve the merges or keep them separate.
assets.duplicates.title: Duplicate review
assets.duplicates.description: Approve or reject merges of assets that look like duplicates.
assets.tagFilter.title: Tags
assets.tagFilter.none: No tags in this workspace yet.
assets.tagFilter.matchAnyHint: Assets with at least one of the selected tags
assets.bulkTags.removeDescription: Remove the ticked tags from the {count} selected assets. Other tags are kept; system tags cannot be removed.
assets.bulkTags.removedPartly: Removed tags from {done} of {count} assets; {failed} failed
assets.attribution.decisionHint.confirme: It belongs to your organization and stays in the inventory. A domain or address also gets its exact scope entry, unless your organization turned this off or uses Strict scan approval.
assets.attribution.decisionHint.rejected: It is not yours. It leaves the inventory, and scans never touch it or the names below it.
assets.attribution.decisionHint.dependen: Your name on someone else’s servers (CDN, SaaS, hosting). Only passive and takeover checks run.
assets.attribution.decisionHint.monitorO: Keep watching it passively (certificates, DNS). It is never actively scanned.
assets.attribution.decisionHint.undo: Clear the decision and let the evidence decide again.
assets.attribution.evidence.assertedRoot: Under {root}, a domain you listed but have not verified
Under a domain you listed but have not verified
assets.attribution.evidence.scanDiscover: Found by a scan your organization ran (not one of its targets)
assets.attribution.hint.ipNeedsIpEntry: Names never grant their addresses; this IP needs its own scope entry.
assets.attribution.legacy: In the inventory before discovery evidence was kept
assets.attribution.network.shared: {who}shared provider space{provider}; it cannot be added, because these addresses serve other organizations.
assets.attribution.note: Confirming a domain or address as yours also adds its exact scope entry, unless your organization turned this off or uses Strict scan approval. Scans reach only what a scope entry (Scoping › Scope) covers.
assets.attribution.question: Is it yours?
assets.attribution.scan.outOfScope: Scans skip this asset: it is confirmed as yours, but no scope target, seed or verified domain covers it. Add it to Scoping › Scope to scan it.
assets.attribution.scan.passive: Scans skip this asset; it is watched passively only.
assets.attribution.scan.unattributed: Scans skip this asset: no scope target, seed or verified domain covers it. Add it to Scoping › Scope.
assets.attribution.scan.underRejected: Scans skip this asset: a name it sits under was marked not yours.
assets.attribution.scan.untilConfirmed: Scans skip this asset until its ownership is confirmed.
assets.attribution.scan.wildcardOnly: Scans skip this asset: the name resolves only through a wildcard DNS record. Confirm it is yours before any active scan.
assets.attribution.scan.discovered: Not in scope: passive only. Discovery found this asset and no scope entry covers it. Add it to scope to scan it.
assets.attribution.scope.internal: A private target: its scan zone decides.
assets.attribution.scope.notApplicable: Scope entries do not apply to this kind of asset.
assets.attribution.scope.outOfScope: Out of scope: no scope entry covers this name.
assets.attribution.title: Ownership and scope
assets.attribution.why: Why the platform thinks it may be yours
assets.triage.title: Mark {count} out of scope
assets.triage.description: Out of scope assets are never scanned actively. They stay in the inventory with their history unless you mark them not yours.
assets.triage.exclude.label: Exclude from scanning
assets.triage.exclude.hint: Adds scope exclusions. Exclusions win over every scope entry.
assets.triage.exclude.skipped: {count} selected need no exclusion (internal names, repositories, cloud accounts).
assets.triage.reject.label: Not ours
assets.triage.reject.hint: Records that these are not your organization’s. Names found again under them stay out too.
assets.triage.preview.total: Together they match {count} assets you can see.
assets.triage.failed: Could not mark out of scope
assets.triage.badge.inScopeHint: A scope entry covers it; scans can reach it.
assets.triage.badge.passiveOnlyHint: Discovery found this asset and no scope entry covers it, so it gets passive checks only. Add it to scope to scan it, or mark it out of scope.
assets.triage.defaultHint: Showing your inventory, including what discovery found (passive only until a scope entry covers it). Names awaiting review and names marked not yours are hidden.
assets.zone.notScanScope: This is the network zone, not the scan scope.
assets.exposure.restricted.hint: Behind authentication or VPN but externally accessible
assets.scanning.title: Scope and scanning
assets.scanning.confirmed: Confirmed as yours; scans may reach it now
